purpose: Native radio input with optional label, description, invalid, disabled, controlled, and uncontrolled states.

guidance.useWhen: Use for single-choice options, usually inside RadioGroup.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for binary settings; use Checkbox or Switch.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Use native Radio for simple choices and keep app state controlled when needed.

limitations: Avoid for binary settings; use Checkbox or Switch.

accessibility.notes: Provide label or aria-label; group related radios with RadioGroup where practical.
